terrain: Production-ready pixel art terrain TEXTURE ATLAS for an original cozy Taiwanese island village life-sim. Warm, richly detailed 16-bit hand-pixelled game art, Stardew-like density but original assets. Exact square 1024x1024 canvas, EXACTLY 4 columns by 4 rows of equal 256x256 squares, no gaps, NO labels, NO grid lines, no borders. Each square is a separate seamless top-down ground texture; logically each square is 32x32 pixel art enlarged exactly 8x, hard square pixels, no gradients, no antialias, no perspective. All share muted sage, olive, golden straw, warm umber, cream and teal palette, light upper left. Texture variation within each square is subtle and sparse so tiling is not noisy. In row-major order: row1 four slightly different meadow grass textures (sage base, olive base, straw mixed, tiny clover), each mostly even green with tiny delicate blade clusters and no objects. row2: warm beige compacted dirt footpath; pale ochre fine beach sand with tiny shell specks; deeper brown loose garden soil; rich watered furrow soil. row3: teal sea with few thin cream ripple strokes; pale turquoise shallows; weathered honey wood horizontal pier planks with nail heads and grain; irregular warm gray cobblestone paving. row4: sparse pastel white and pink wildflowers on SAME green meadow ground; olive moss ground; gravel footpath matching row2 dirt; darker umber soil dry furrows. Fill every square edge to edge. No trees, no buildings, no characters. Do not make landscape scene. This atlas will be sliced into actual 32px Godot tiles.
props: Create a production pixel-art SPRITE ATLAS for an original warm cozy Taiwanese island village game, polished 16-bit hand-pixelled sprites with rich leaf clusters, wood grain, tiny flowers. EXACTLY 1024x1024 image divided into 4 columns and 4 rows of invisible equal 256x256 cells. One sprite per cell, fully contained, centered horizontally, feet/bottom aligned at y=224 within each cell, blank margin >=16px all sides. No text, no labels, no grid lines, NO terrain patches, NO scene background. Background MUST be flat uniform pure #FF00FF magenta so a game importer can chroma-key it; no magenta within any sprite, no shadows extending far from the object. Pixel art at logical 64x64 per cell enlarged exactly 4x, square hard pixels, NO smooth/vector/3D painting. Consistent orthographic top-down RPG three-quarter view, light from upper left. Restrained warm olive, sage, teal, cream, terracotta and honey wood palette. Row 1 left to right: large lush broadleaf oak with irregular leaf-cluster silhouette and visible roots; tall slender dark teal pine; white-trunk birch with yellow-green airy canopy; smaller amber-green maple. These four are 45-56 logical pixels tall. Row 2: low flowering pink hydrangea bush; small cluster of white daisies and ferns; irregular mossy shoreline gray boulder; tuft of mixed meadow grass and tiny yellow flowers. Row 3: small charming wooden produce stall with cream and faded terracotta striped fabric canopy and baskets of vegetables, NO shopkeeper; rustic wooden community noticeboard with tiny pinned cream papers, no readable text; stacked wooden crates and one barrel with rope; small honey-wood bench with flower planter. Row 4: weathered wood mooring platform with posts and coiled rope seen from above, fits square; little wooden rowboat with oars and blue folded cloth seen from above; tiny beach composition of two shells, sea grass and driftwood; wooden wayfinding post with two blank arrows and a small lantern. Each separate sprite is for slicing and real Godot use, NOT a mockup scene.

mcp.result: Watermarked outputs archived for provenance only; never imported into renderer.
